requiredProofContract.proofGate: Verify actual approved rollover fact and atomic claim pinning version/content hash/approval actor-role-time. Rollover content pins NextExaminationId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextPeriodId and dates. Observe actual Type I entry approval; actual human-created successor examination; exact frozen Type I baseline, auditor outcome and approved/bound system-description version; human-authored source-validated TypeIIPlan; exhaustive carry-forward mapping; independent review and executive approval. Then submit exact period start. Pending admission is not completion; require actual started chain with immutable opening intent, native root/result, exact source and target facts/hashes, period/range and calendar authorization ID/generation.
requiredProofContract.mappingManifest: Each rollover record and commitment maps exactly once to a TypeIIPlan destination or justified nonrepresentation consistent with approved disposition; exact source/version/hash, complete frozen manifest/hash; reject omissions, duplicates, mismatch and unsupported conversion.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: exact rollover version and approval tuple pinned before successor work
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: same tenant/program/rollover, version/content hash and approver identity/role/time; claim content binds NextExaminationId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextPeriodId and dates.
actual current approved/approved_with_exceptions readiness decision; actual examination event same tenant/program and exact NextExaminationId, with approved next dates.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: complete Type I prerequisite source chain
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: same NextExaminationId; frozen baseline ID/hash and complete manifest; recorded auditor Type I outcome bound to exact baseline/hash; approved description version exists in baseline and is actually bound for same examination, type_i_baseline purpose and baseline ID.

requiredTypedStageProofSets.role: complete human-authored successor plan and independent governance
requiredTypedStageProofSets.requiredVerification: same NextTypeIIPlanId and NextExaminationId; current version hash; baseline/outcome/description source IDs and hashes exact; dates match rollover; complete exhaustive carry-forward mapping; reviewer and executive approver distinct from proposer and each other; actual facts.
exact NextPeriodId, NextTypeIIPlanId, NextExaminationId and dates; immutable intent and original 202; pending only.
actual native chain to accepted opening; exact period stream/range and plan ID/version/hash; operation root/result and calendar authorization ID/generation.

requiredProofContract.recoveryContract: Persist before starter checkpoint; retry deterministic exact identities; observe human decisions only through actual typed facts; after lost append reload and verify actual facts. Missing dependencies retry; invalid/mismatched proofs quarantine. Rejection/failure never implies success or release; accepted remains pending, started is complete. A changes_requested plan version loops through an exact revised version and new complete mapping; a rejected plan terminates as failed. Missing Type I prerequisites wait/retry under their exact owners; the process never fabricates a baseline, outcome, description or examination. A changes_requested plan loops to human revision/remapping; explicit reject is terminal failed. An opening rejection is never started.
requiredProofContract.crossOwnerCorrelation: Private process record is rooted in actual ProgramRolloverExecutionClaimed. It verifies every fact on the owner-specific tenant/program/examination/baseline/plan/period stream named by the pinned content. The next plan and period commands repeat exact NextExaminationId/NextTypeIIPlanId/NextPeriodId; mismatched owner identities cannot advance.

prerequisiteVerification.admission: The receiver resolves the original admitted root fact by its exact owner, tenant, episode, actor and immutable intent, and verifies the saved fact and content hash before acting; a reference alone grants nothing.
prerequisiteVerification.stageProofs: Each required stage proof (grant, hold, review, or terminal fact) is materialised from the actual committed fact and its full immutable selection; counts, checkpoints and stage order are not accepted as proof.

effectIdentity.rule: Use an explicitly versioned injective length-prefixed encoding for this new domain; preserve any occupied IDs unchanged; fixed vectors required before activation.

recoveryContract.lostAcknowledgement: If the receiver's append succeeded but the acknowledgement was lost, redelivery resolves the same deterministic effect identity and returns the original committed result without a second append.
recoveryContract.retryAfterPartialProgress: A retry re-reads the target stream; a proven superseded or already-applied operation is a terminal no-op; an unavailable dependency or unknown append outcome is transient and retried; changed intent or an invalid proof is a permanent conflict and the operation is quarantined.
recoveryContract.concurrencyConflict: On an optimistic-concurrency conflict at the target the receiver re-reads and re-decides under the target's current state; it never overwrites a newer decision.
recoveryContract.abortOfAdmittedRoot: If the admitted root is cancelled or the process is aborted, the bound abort receiver fences the target so a delayed delivery cannot apply, and any held reservation is released only after the fence is durable.
recoveryContract.source: Canonical recovery contract stated in four cases on 2026-10-29; semantically equal to the former one-sentence contract, which is retained as `recoveryContractSummary`.
